# R14 Shinobi library — staged, not accepted production art
Pinned 3 public GitHub source trees: complete Android character directory, all Studio data ZIP/catalog files, and Vault snapshot. Download only data, verify original git blob hash/length. Keep all source bytes, extract already-exported PNG atlas cels using exact rect/pivot/timing, generate GIFs, inventory ZIP contents and candidate mapping against 144 ninja and 54 forms. Catalog-only models are not claimed downloaded as complete sprites; texture URLs and Spine archives require separate completeness checks. No original source game code is run, no rig in Naru, no mirroring, no gameplay edits, no merge. The artifact is a review/staging library, not automatic publication to the game. Check redistribution rights before publishing external assets in the public Web. Protected character sprites remain unchanged.
